# ColumnaQuiro

> Chiropractic clinic in València, Spain (Russafa / L'Eixample). Two chiropractors, consultations in Spanish, English and French. First visit 70 €: full assessment, first adjustment and a care plan. Bookings online, nothing to pay when booking.

- Address: Carrer dels Vivons, 29, Bajo Izquierdo, 46006 València, Spain
- Phone: +34 744 73 53 63
- Hours: Tuesday to Thursday, 09:00–13:00 and 15:00–20:00
- Nearest metro: Xàtiva. Parking: Mercado de Ruzafa car park.
- Focus: lower back pain, neck pain, sciatica, headaches from the neck, pregnancy-related back and pelvic pain. Chiropractic does not treat neurodevelopmental, digestive or other non-musculoskeletal conditions; the site says so on each page.
